# Epistle of Barnabas — Chapter 8 (PNEUMA Dynamic)

**Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, Epistle of Barnabas 8
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. What is the type hidden in the command given to Israel? The men who bear the sin must take a heifer, slaughter it and burn it. Then the children take the ashes, put them in vessels, tie scarlet wool — there again is the type of the cross and the red wool — around a stick along with hyssop, and the children sprinkle the people one by one to purify them from their sins.
2. See how simply he is speaking to you. The heifer is Jesus. The men who offer it are the sinners who handed him over to death. And then — there are no more men. The glory no longer belongs to sinners.
3. The children who do the sprinkling are those who proclaimed to us forgiveness of sins and the cleansing of the heart. The Lord gave them authority to preach the gospel — they are twelve in number, as a type of the twelve tribes of Israel.
4. Why are there three children sprinkling? To bear witness to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, for those three were great before God.
5. Why is the wool placed on the wood? Because the kingdom of Jesus is on the wood, and because those who hope in him will live forever.
6. Why are the wool and the hyssop together? Because in his kingdom there will be dark and polluted days — and in those days we will be saved. The person who is sick in body is healed by the sharp, purging quality of hyssop.
7. All of this is clear to us, but dark to them — because they never really listened to the Lord's voice.
